Subject: Post-call: Performance & SLO qualification - load test next steps

Hi Samantha / Carlos —

Great to meet earlier — thanks for the productive call. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we stay aligned on the performance/SLO items we discussed: 

Summary of SLO targets you mentioned:
- P95 latency: <= 300ms for non-streaming generation endpoints
- Streaming endpoints (token-by-token): tail latency SLA for first token <= 150ms, steady-state per-token latency target <= 25ms
- Throughput: target sustained throughput of ~2,000 requests/minute with spikes to 4,000 RPM during business hours
- Concurrency: target concurrency of 500 concurrent sessions for the streaming endpoint

What Redwood will need from FinWise to run the customer-led load test:
1) A test account and API key scoped for load testing (non-prod)
2) IP allowlist entries we can add (we'll provide our load generator IPs)
3) Preferred test window (2-hour window to include ramp, sustain, and cooldown)
4) Confirmation of endpoints and request templates for streaming vs non-streaming flows

Attachments I can send: a k6 script template we typically use and an allowlist file for your security team.

Proposed next step: If you can confirm a 2-hour window on Wed 24 Mar or Thu 25 Mar (UTC/PST times below), Neha (cc'ed) will share the test credentials and final k6 script. We'll also provide a run-of-show and monitoring checklist.

Proposed windows (example):
- Wed 24 Mar 10:00–12:00 PST (18:00–20:00 UTC)
- Thu 25 Mar 14:00–16:00 PST (22:00–00:00 UTC)

Let me know which works best or suggest alternatives.

Thanks —
Logan Wright

Hi Samantha — looping in technical details and the test artifacts.

Attached: finwise-k6-script.js, allowlist-ips.txt, test-account-credentials.txt (these are stubs in this thread; we will upload the actual files to the secure Drive link once you confirm the window).

Key technical notes for the load test:
- Script type: k6 (v0.43+) — we include an SSE helper for streaming tests. If you prefer Locust, we can convert quickly.
- Test plan (default):
  * Ramp: 15 minutes linear ramp to 500 VUs
  * Sustain: 30 minutes at 500 VUs (sustained load to observe tail latency and memory behavior)
  * Spike test: 10-minute burst to 1,200 VUs to validate graceful degradation/fallbacks
  * Cooldown: 15 minutes ramp down
- Target endpoints: /v1/generate (non-streaming), /v1/generate-stream (streaming SSE)
- Headers: Authorization: Bearer <test-api-key>, X-Client-Id: finwise-loadtest-1
- Payloads: We will parameterize prompts to mimic real distribution (short chat prompts + long-context prompts).
- Streaming specifics: We exercise the SSE path and measure time-to-first-token and per-token latency. k6 script includes an SSE client that records first-byte times.

IP allowlist: We will provide a small set of static egress IPs for the k6 runners (these are the ones in allowlist-ips.txt). If your security team requires more dynamic runners, we can provide a CIDR range instead.

Test account: After you confirm the window, we'll provision a non-prod API key and send credentials via your secure channel (we can also use a temporary password-protected doc). The test key will be scoped to the test endpoints and revoked after the test.

Monitoring & run-of-show:
- Redwood will monitor:
  * p50/p95/p99 request latency (streaming and non-streaming)
  * first-token latency for streaming endpoints
  * tokens/sec and requests/sec per model shard
  * GPU utilization, batch size, queue lengths
  * Error rates (4xx/5xx) and model fallsbacks
- We'll share a live dashboard link during the test and a 1-hour postmortem (summary metrics + recommendations).

Proposed deliverables by Mon EOD:
- Finalized k6 script (finwise-k6-script.js)
- allowlist-ips.txt (3 static IPs)
- test-account-credentials.txt (test API key + scope)
- Run-of-show doc (10–15 minute PDF)

Let us know if you want us to run the load test from our side as well; otherwise we'll hand over artifacts and validate with you during the customer-led run.

Thanks —
Neha Kapoor
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
neha_kapoor@redwoodinference.com
